summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5), Registration No. 333-296395) dated November 2, 2026 for a multi-tranche senior unsecured debt offering comprising floating rate notes tied to three-month EURIBOR plus a spread and six fixed-rate series of varying maturities. Amounts, coupons, and maturities are left blank pending pricing. Notes rank pari passu with existing unsubordinated debt and structurally subordinated to subsidiary obligations; optional make-whole redemption applies to fixed tranches, tax-redemption to all. Listing on Nasdaq Bond Exchange targeted within 30 days of issue; T+3 settlement via Clearstream/Euroclear. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch pricing spreads and final tranche sizing for balance-sheet signaling.
